archetypes.name: waterfall
archetypes.rationale: The diff rewires vendor availability, no-fallback behavior, Codex phase-1 dispatch, and dropped-slot propagation across the review waterfall.
archetypes.prompt_body: Investigate the dispatch-panel and waterfall integration paths for availability-gated Cursor/Codex rows, conditional no-fallback behavior, Codex phase-1 enablement, and dropped-slot metadata forwarding. Pay special attention to single-vendor and both-vendors-down cases where fallback semantics intentionally differ from both-vendor manifests. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: thresholds
archetypes.rationale: The change depends on subtle reviewer slot accounting and failure-threshold math across static, dynamic, dropped, and fallback outputs.
archetypes.prompt_body: Examine the failure-threshold and review-core accounting logic for intended slots, launched slots, dropped static peers, phase-2 or phase-3 static failures, and dynamic Codex twin exclusion. Verify that per-archetype coverage cannot silently disappear when aggregate failure counts still pass. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: promptctx
archetypes.rationale: The folded testing reviewer now receives implementation plans in more modes, increasing prompt-context and untrusted-input handling risk.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the specialist prompt rendering changes around reviewer-testing plan injection across diff modes and description mode. Check whether untrusted plan content is consistently delimited, scoped only to the intended agent, and not accidentally exposed to unrelated specialists. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: artifacts
archetypes.rationale: The implementation touches generated/pre-rendered artifacts, topology projections, diagrams, and doc-sync harnesses that can drift independently.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect generated and pre-rendered artifact synchronization, including reviewer prompt bodies, manifests, topology docs, public phrase replacements, and diagram or harness expectations. Look for stale six-specialist wording, generator contract mismatches, or artifacts that no longer match their source files. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: runlogs
archetypes.rationale: Static Codex transcript exclusion versus dynamic Codex retention is a narrow logging contract with privacy and forensic implications.
archetypes.prompt_body: Check the run-log inclusion and exclusion changes for static codex-specialist outputs, matching sidecars, phased outputs, and dynamic dyn-*-codex outputs. Verify the tests prove the intended privacy boundary without discarding dynamic reviewer evidence needed for diagnostics. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
